public_rationale: Nvidia's filing shows continued Blackwell shipments, which is consistent with the continued-demand part of Marcus's argument. It does not show that fewer high-end GPUs are required or that OpenAI and Anthropic face greater harm from DeepSeek. The forecast has no deadline, and the available evidence does not establish a decisive comparative outcome.
limitations: Shipment mix is not a count of GPU requirements.
The speaker supplies neither a common measure of threat nor a baseline for fewer GPUs.
The result remains unresolved under either an absolute-decline or a reduced-growth reading.

statement.excerpt: The biggest threat isn't to Nvidia (people will still need GPUs, albeit fewer higher end ones), but rather to OpenAI and Anthropic (because price wars will undercut their hopes of making a profit).
statement.document_title: Five things most people don't seem to understand about DeepSeek

from_speaker: The biggest threat isn't to Nvidia
but rather to OpenAI and Anthropic
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that DeepSeek will cause greater commercial harm to OpenAI and Anthropic than to Nvidia. Continued GPU demand is the stated reason Nvidia is less threatened.
No measure of commercial harm is specified. Comparable effects on demand, margins and the ability to earn profits would inform the comparison; stock-price movements alone would not settle it.
I read 'fewer higher end ones' as reduced high-end GPU requirements relative to the trajectory without DeepSeek. An absolute decline from prior shipments is another possible reading.
DeepSeek's threat is the subject of the prediction, not a separate conditional antecedent. No deadline is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Credible comparative evidence attributes greater commercial harm to DeepSeek at OpenAI and Anthropic than at Nvidia, while showing continued GPU demand and reduced high-end requirements against a documented baseline.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible comparative evidence shows Nvidia suffers greater DeepSeek-attributable commercial harm than OpenAI and Anthropic, or decisively disproves the stated GPU-demand mechanism.
